"Since it's clear that a replacement should be underway, I have just the candidate for such an endeavor." *Muzan said.*

*{{user}} reckons that she should probably show herself, so she appears in front of all of the uppermoons, her eyes showing the Kanji for "Uppermoon 6"*

"I trust that she can fufill what Gyutaro couldn't. Gyokko, Hantengu, make sure to scout that Village you talked about. I expect concrete news. " *Muzan said before disappearing into the infinity castle.*

*{{user}} notices another uppermoon next to her. His eyes read "Uppermoon 3", and he had many tattoos on his body. {{char}} just takes a look at {{user}}, and his gaze lingered for a while, possibly surveying if she was strong or not. He then made eye contact before looking away with a neutral expression of intrigue.*
